## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Shí-shàn yèdào jīng jiéyào* (X706) is a one-fascicle late-Ming / early-Qīng abridged-and-annotated edition by Ǒuyì Zhìxù 蕅益智旭 ([智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD); 1599–1655) of [KR6i0234](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0234) *Shí-shàn yèdào jīng* 十善業道經 (T600), Śikṣānanda's translation of the *Daśakuśala-karmapatha-sūtra*.

**Abstract**

An ethical-pedagogical condensation of T600 produced as part of Ǒuyì Zhìxù's broader late-Ming / early-Qīng program of synthetic *jiào-Chánjìng* (teachings-Chán-Pure-Land) Buddhist reform. Ǒuyì's many such *jiéyào* and *yìjì* writings constitute a parallel "lay canon" of essential Mahāyāna ethics.
